input: Find family-owned German machine-tool manufacturers (Mittelstand) with 100-500 employees

companies.name: HEDELIUS Maschinenfabrik GmbH
companies.traction: More than 3,000 machining centres delivered and counted among the leading European manufacturers; CrefoZert creditworthiness certificate continuously since 2016; equity ratio of 70%; over 250 automated machining centres in the market; revenue more than doubled in the last 10 years at high profitability (MD interview, 04/2025)
companies.employees: ~250 ('rund 250 Mitarbeiter', VDWF member profile; band 101-250); LinkedIn band 201-500 (as_of 2026-11-09)
companies.ownership: Family-owned - own site calls it 'ein unabhängiges Familienunternehmen'; managed by the Hempelmann family (managing director Dennis Hempelmann; predecessor Jürgen/Gerhard Hempelmann); shareholder Hedelius Vertriebsgesellschaft mbH per registry; no PE/VC signals found
companies.rank_reason: Highest fit: pure CNC machining-centre builder, independent 2nd-generation family ownership, ~250 employees squarely in range, 70% equity ratio and a documented decade of profitable revenue growth; no external ownership events found.
companies.headcount_growth: VDWF member band 101-250 (member since 2024) consistent with ~250 today; no earlier dated headcount published - as proxy, revenue more than doubled over the last 10 years (04/2025 interview)

criteria_evidence.evidence: Register purpose: 'Herstellung und der Vertrieb von Maschinen, insbesondere Werkzeugmaschinen' (AG Osnabrück HRB 120051); builds vertical CNC-Fahrständer-Bearbeitungszentren (ACURA, TILTENTA, FORTE) with automation
'ein unabhängiges Familienunternehmen' (independent family-owned company), founded 1967, headquartered in Meppen
'Die Hedelius Maschinenfabrik in Meppen wurde im Jahr 1967 gegründet und beschäftigt heute rund 250 Mitarbeiter'; VDWF states 'Anzahl der Mitarbeiter: 101-250'

companies.hq: Harald-Friedrich-Str. 2-8, 83352 Altenmarkt a.d. Alz, Bavaria, Germany
companies.name: ALZMETALL GmbH & Co. KG
companies.traction: Over 230,000 machines delivered worldwide; self-described market leader in column drilling machines; Federal Prize (Bundespreis) 2002 for the G 800 machining centre; revenue €49M (2022), €40.4M (2021); 80th anniversary celebrated 2025
companies.employees: 284 average employees in FY2021 (audited annual accounts via Fusionbase); LinkedIn band 201-500 (as_of 2026-11-09); Wikipedia cites 323 employees (2021)
companies.ownership: Family/founder lineage: legal form GmbH & Co. KG with personally liable partner 'Harald Friedrich Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung' (founder Harald Friedrich); limited partners include Friedrich family members (Heiner Friedrich, Heike Friedrich, Helga Reich); no PE/VC signals found in registry or news
companies.rank_reason: 80-year-old builder of drilling machines, 5-axis machining centres and its own iron foundry; 284 employees (FY2021) well inside range; deep aerospace/automotive customer base; ownership is family-lineage but the site does not state 'Familienunternehmen' in as many words as peers - hence rank 2 not 1.
companies.headcount_growth: 'Über 400 Mitarbeiter' already in the 1961-1965 era (company history) → 284 average employees FY2021 (annual accounts); LinkedIn band 201-500 today

criteria_evidence.evidence: Werkzeugmaschinenfabrik und Gießerei (machine-tool factory and foundry), Altenmarkt a.d. Alz; products: drilling machines, milling/machining centres, own grey/ductile iron foundry
Founded 1945 by Harald Friedrich and Peter Meier; personally liable partner Harald Friedrich GmbH; Friedrich family members among limited partners (AG Traunstein HRA 2638)
'Die durchschnittliche Arbeitnehmerzahl im Berichtsjahr betrug: ... 284' (FY2021 annual accounts); LinkedIn employee band 201-500

companies.name: Röders GmbH
companies.traction: Technology leader in high-speed-cutting (HSC) milling machines with sub-micron precision; PET blow moulds used by fillers for Coca-Cola, Pepsi-Cola and Schweppes; own subsidiaries in China, Hong Kong, France, Taiwan, USA, Vietnam; revenue class €50-100M
companies.employees: 375 in Germany (wer-zu-wem company profile); ~395 employees at the Soltau site (Heidekreis business portal); 250 employees with €74M revenue (2017, DDW family-company ranking)
companies.ownership: Family-owned - Gesellschafter: Röders family; 'in Familienbesitz seit 1789', sixth generation of family management, managing partner and owner Jürgen Röders; no PE/VC signals found
companies.rank_reason: 237-year-old, sixth-generation family company with a genuine machine-tool core (HSC milling/grinding machines and controls) and ~375-395 employees; rank 3 because machine-tool share sits alongside the legacy pewter and blow-mould businesses and founding year predates the machine business.
companies.headcount_growth: 250 employees (2017, DDW family ranking) → 375 in Germany (wer-zu-wem profile) / ~395 at the Soltau site (Heidekreis portal)

criteria_evidence.evidence: Business field Hochgeschwindigkeitsfräsen (HSC milling) with self-developed machines, controls and drive technology; technology leader in HSC milling machines of high precision (sub-micron)
'Familienunternehmen, Gesellschafter Röders Familie, in Familienbesitz seit 1789, Geschäftsführer & Inhaber Jürgen Röders' (DDW family ranking names Familie Röders as Inhaber)
'Anzahl Mitarbeiter: 375 in Deutschland' (wer-zu-wem); '~395 Mitarbeiter/-innen am Standort Soltau' (workandlife-heidekreis)

companies.hq: Friedrich K. Eisler Str. 1, 91448 Emskirchen (Mausdorf), Bavaria, Germany
companies.name: Weiler Werkzeugmaschinen GmbH
companies.traction: 'Hidden Champion und Marktführer bei Präzisions-Drehmaschinen' in the German-speaking region; over 160,000 machines sold worldwide; 8 IP filings in 2023 alone; WEILER North America since 2006
companies.employees: ~300 at the Emskirchen/Mausdorf German HQ plus ~220 at Holoubkov (CZ) subsidiary - 'Rund 500 Beschäftigte' group-wide (85th-anniversary release, 20 June 2023); DDW profile cites ~550; LinkedIn band 201-500
companies.ownership: Family-owned (Familienunternehmen der Familie Eisler): 1995 management buy-out by Dkfm. Friedrich K. Eisler, now led by his sons as geschäftsführende Gesellschafter (Michael Eisler MBA, Mag. Alexander Eisler); shareholder FKE Beteiligungsgesellschaft mbH; no PE/VC signals found
companies.rank_reason: Strong family ownership (two brothers as managing partners) and market-leader position in precision lathes; rank 4 because the German entity is ~300 employees but the group incl. the Czech subsidiary sits at ~500-550, right at the thesis boundary, and headcount has not grown since 2012.
companies.headcount_growth: ~550 employees at Emskirchen and Holoubkov (2012, company history) → ~500 group-wide 'Rund 500 Beschäftigte' (June 2023 anniversary release)

criteria_evidence.evidence: Register purpose: 'Betrieb einer Werkzeugmaschinenfabrik, insbesondere die Herstellung von Werkzeugmaschinen und anderen Maschinen' (AG Fürth HRB 8660); makes conventional, cycle-controlled and CNC precision lathes and drilling machines
'Das Familienunternehmen' (Eisler family): management page lists the two geschäftsführende Gesellschafter Michael Eisler and Alexander Eisler; 1995 MBO by Friedrich K. Eisler, sons joined 2001

'Rund 500 Beschäftigte und ihre Angehörigen haben am Samstag das 85. Gründungsjubiläum ... gefeiert' (20 June 2023) - German HQ ≈300 plus ~220 in Holoubkov/CZ per same release; DDW profile 'Rund 550 Mitarbeiter'

companies.name: FOOKE GmbH
companies.traction: 'Market leader in 1:1 machining in German automotive design' and in machining of aluminium profiles; ~2/3 of order intake from Europe, 1/3 from America, with strong aerospace/space demand; EMO Hannover 2025 exhibitor (Hall 13, C32). Caveat: local press reported short-time work (Kurzarbeit) at the Borken plant
companies.employees: ~200 ('mit rund 200 Mitarbeitern am Standort Borken', own career page); LinkedIn band 51-200 (as_of 2026-11-09)
companies.ownership: Family-owned - 'the FOOKE family has been shaping the history of machine tool engineering' since over 120 years, led in 4th/5th generation by Johannes and Hendrik Fooke; Borkener Zeitung (06.11.2026): Hendrik Fooke runs the company 'in fünfter Generation'; no PE/VC signals found
companies.rank_reason: Genuine 5th-generation family machine-tool builder (~200 employees) with differentiated gantry milling/FSW niche; rank 5 because headcount (~200) is near the lower half of the band and local press reported Kurzarbeit, implying cyclicality.

criteria_evidence.evidence: German machine-tool manufacturer of portal (gantry) milling machines, long-bed milling machines and friction-stir-welding systems; EMO Hannover 2025 exhibitor

'For over 120 years, the FOOKE family has been shaping the history of machine tool engineering. From a small family business in Borken ... led in the 4th and 5th generation by Johannes and Hendrik Fooke'; 'FOOKE ist ein modern geführtes Familienunternehmen'
'mit rund 200 Mitarbeitern am Standort Borken' (own career page); LinkedIn employee_count_range 51-200

companies.name: RATTUNDE AG
companies.traction: 'Von der Garagenfirma zum technologischen Weltmarktführer'; revenue €55.8M with €2.8M profit (latest accounts); successful TUBE 2026 trade-fair appearance (Apr 2026); 35th-anniversary open house 2025; own subsidiaries in USA (Caledonia, MI), Mexico (Zapopan) and Japan (Yokohama)
companies.employees: 270 employees (FirmenData, register data as of 05.11.2026); LinkedIn band 201-500
companies.ownership: Family-owned - since 2018 RATTUNDE AG is 'das gemeinsame Unternehmen der Familien Proksch und Rattunde', whose shareholders 'wie bisher zu gleichen Teilen die beiden Familien sind'; Vorstand Ulrich Rattunde, Martin Proksch; no PE/VC signals found
companies.rank_reason: Youngest company on the list (1990) but equally owned by two founding families, 270 employees and €55.8M revenue with a world-market-leader niche in tube/rod end-machining systems; rank 6 due to shorter track record and AG structure with no headcount history available.

criteria_evidence.evidence: 'Die Rattunde AG ... ist auf die Entwicklung und Herstellung von Werkzeugmaschinen spezialisiert' (ACS production systems); NACE C.28.41.0 'Herstellung von Werkzeugmaschinen für die Metallbearbeitung'
'Rattunde AG ist ein Familienunternehmen'; since 2018 held 'zu gleichen Teilen' by the Proksch and Rattunde families (own site, Über uns)
'Mitarbeiter 270' (FirmenData, Amtsgericht Schwerin HRB 13106, Stand 05.11.2026); ranked 'Platz 5.184 von 16.109 - Top-Arbeitgeber mit 100 bis 500 Mitarbeitern'

companies.name: LASCO Umformtechnik GmbH
companies.traction: Listed among the ~1,466 German Weltmarktführer (segment 'Werkzeugmaschinen für Metallmassivumformung, Blechumformung sowie Kalksandsteinproduktion') and among Hidden Champions; claims 'we rank among the technology leaders in the industry'; 52 apprentices (2024); customer Pietro Rosa TBM running LASCO presses since 2011
companies.employees: 400 employees (DDW company profile, as of 30.04.2026); 474 employees (2012, Wikipedia); 320 (PitchBook profile)
companies.ownership: Family-owned - Wikipedia: 'bis heute mehrheitlich Eigentum der Gründerfamilie Langenstein'; held via holding Langenstein & Schemann GmbH whose partners include Dr. Bernd Langenstein; no PE/VC signals found
companies.rank_reason: 163-year-old family-owned press builder with 400 employees and a Weltmarktführer niche; rank 7 because headcount trended down from 474 (2012) to 400 (2026) and the majority holder is a family holding rather than operating family members at the top.
companies.headcount_growth: 474 employees (2012, Wikipedia infobox) → 400 employees (DDW profile, as of 30.04.2026); PitchBook cites 320

criteria_evidence.evidence: 'Die LASCO Umformtechnik GmbH stellt Werkzeugmaschinen und Produktionsanlagen für Umformaufgaben her' - hydraulic presses for sheet metal forming, forging hammers, sand-lime block presses
'Das im Jahr 1863 gegründete Unternehmen ist bis heute mehrheitlich Eigentum der Gründerfamilie Langenstein'; Gesellschafter is Langenstein & Schemann GmbH with family members among its partners
'Mitarbeiter: 400' (DDW company profile, as of 30.04.2026); Wikipedia Mitarbeiterzahl 474 (2012)

companies.hq: Allee 16 (Werk 1; Werk 2: Otto-Hahn-Str. 27), 33161 Hövelhof, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Germany
companies.name: ELHA-MASCHINENBAU Liemke GmbH & Co. KG
companies.traction: Customers include large-bearing manufacturers, automotive OEMs and their suppliers, plus energy and aerospace; ISO 9001/ISO 14001 certified since 2005, VDA 6.4 since 2012; machines sold/represented in Japan, China, Korea, USA and Mexico
companies.employees: 240 employees ('ein mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit 240 Mitarbeitern', company fact sheet FS-DE-01-2026); 200 employees with ~€50M revenue (DDW family ranking, 26.01.2024)
companies.ownership: Family-owned - Liemke family (Inhaber), led 'in dritter Generation' by managing directors Hans-Georg Liemke and Christof Liemke; legal form changed from KG to GmbH & Co. KG effective 01.01.2026; no PE/VC signals found
companies.rank_reason: Genuine third-generation family special-machine builder with growing headcount (200→240) inside the band; rank 8 because it builds bespoke machining centres/turnkey systems rather than a serial machine-tool programme, making it more of a special-purpose-machine shop than a classic Werkzeugmaschinenfabrik.
companies.headcount_growth: 200 employees (26.01.2024, DDW family ranking) → 240 employees (2026 company fact sheet FS-DE-01-2026)

criteria_evidence.evidence: '... der Konstruktion und Herstellung von meist spanabhebenden Werkzeugmaschinen und TurnKey-Lösungen' (fact sheet); product lines VTM vertical turn-mill centres, RTX rotary-table machining centres, SMX/SPX special machining centres
'ELHA ist ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen'; managing directors Hans-Georg Liemke and Christof Liemke lead 'in dritter Generation'; DDW family ranking lists Familie Liemke as Inhaber
'Die Firma ELHA-MASCHINENBAU Liemke GmbH & Co. KG ist ein mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit 240 Mitarbeitern' (2026 fact sheet)

companies.name: Priess, Horstmann & Co. Maschinenbau GmbH & Co. KG
companies.traction: 'Die Anzahl der nationalen und internationalen Kunden wächst auf über 200' (2001-2010); 1,000th machine delivered in the 1990s; 'one of the top companies for drilling and assembly technology in the world' (Ligna 2025 exhibitor, Hall 12 E50); machines in use worldwide
companies.employees: ~150 employees ('ca. 150 Mitarbeiter*innen', own site; Ligna 2025 profile: 'more than 100 highly trained specialist personnel')
companies.ownership: Family-owned, second generation - founded 1 April 1970 by Wilfried Prieß, Ewald Horstmann and Reinold Prieß; since 2014 led by Wilfried Prieß's sons Björn and Sven Prieß; self-described 'Familienunternehmen' / 'eigentümergeführtes, mittelständisches Unternehmen'; no PE/VC signals found
companies.rank_reason: Clean family succession (2nd generation) and steady 30→150 headcount growth over four decades, but smallest of the list (~150) and focused on furniture-production machinery (woodworking segment) rather than metal-cutting machine tools - hence rank 9.
companies.headcount_growth: 30 employees (1980s) → 60 (1990s) → 90+ (2010s) → 150 (2020) per company history; Ligna 2025 profile confirms 'more than 100' specialists

criteria_evidence.evidence: Maschinenfabrik producing drilling, edge-processing, six-sided processing and carcase-assembly machines and feeding/handling systems for furniture production ('Hightech-Maschinen für die Möbelfertigung' since 1970)
'eine Familienunternehmens' run in second generation by Björn Prieß and Sven Prieß (managing directors since 2014); career page: 'eigentümergeführte, mittelständische Unternehmen'
'Seit 1970 produzieren bei Priess + Horstmann ca. 150 Mitarbeiter*innen Hightech-Maschinen für die Möbelfertigung'; Ligna 2025: 'more than 100 highly trained specialist personnel'

output.search_notes: Method: candidate universe drawn from the VDW (German Machine Tool Builders' Association) member directory and EMO Hannover 2025 exhibitor index, cross-checked against the VDWF member list, DDW 'Mittelstand 10.000'/'largest family companies' rankings, local business press and each company's own site; ownership verified via Handelsregister extracts (online-handelsregister.de, North Data, CompanyHouse/FirmenData) and company-history pages. All 9 listed companies were re-checked for PE/ownership events in 2024-2026 news - none found. VERIFIED EXCLUSIONS (fail one or more criteria): Carl Benzinger GmbH (Pforzheim, 1916, ~160 emp.) - majority sold to Syngroh Capital (Klaus Grohe family office) Jan 2024, no longer family-owned; Kern Microtechnik GmbH (Eschenlohe, ~286 emp.) - acquired by US-listed AMETEK (announced 04.02.2025); SCHERER Feinbau GmbH - majority bought by Chiron Group (itself PE-controlled); Georg Kesel GmbH & Co. KG (Kempten, 1889) - GESCO SE subsidiary since 2009; Profilator GmbH & Co. KG (Wuppertal) - acquired by PE Accursia Capital (30.04.2025); Gebr. Heller Maschinenfabrik (Nürtingen, ~2,500 emp.) - H.I.G. Capital majority 02/2025, sold to DN Solutions 08/2025; Wirtz Werkzeugbau (Krefeld) - sold to Deutsche Invest Capital Partner (12/2023). SIZE-FIT EXCLUSIONS: ZOLLER (~800 group), VOLLMER (~800 group), WALDRICH COBURG (LinkedIn band 501-1,000), Alfred H. Schütte (~600), SPINNER (~670 group; 300 at Sauerlach HQ), Geibel & Hotz (~85, below 100), EiMa (36), Otto Bihler (>1,000), Heinrich Georg (>1,000). Weiler is included at the upper boundary (German entity ~300; group incl. Holoubkov/CZ ~500-550). SCOPE EXCLUSIONS (not machine-tool builders): AVANTEC Zerspantechnik (cutting tools), Peiseler (rotary tables/angular heads = machine-tool components), A. Mannesmann Maschinenfabrik (part of Swiss SCHNEEBERGER Group, machine elements), Kurt Grützmann Feinmechanik (contract machining), WTO GmbH (tool holders). Gaps: second dated headcounts are not published for Hedelius, FOOKE and RATTUNDE (headcount_growth null there); no external funding rounds exist for any listed family-owned company (all null; each company's news and registry pages were checked for investor involvement without hits).
